findings.title: The score pill is a control that never joined the card's own coarse-pointer 44 px target floor
findings.claim: On the plan card the headline optimization-score pill carries role="button", tabindex="0" and the click that opens the score breakdown, yet under a coarse pointer it renders 25 px tall (158.02 x 25) at 375x812 and 39 px tall (158.02 x 39) at 768x1024 and 1280x800, under the card's own TARGET_MIN_PX_COARSE = 44 px; it is the only control in the 528-cell matrix that lands under the floor.
findings.mechanism: heatpump-optimizer-card.js builds one htmlTargetFloor template (2969-2989) whose selector list is the register of controls on the HTML surface, with min-height/min-width set to _coarsePointer() ? 44 : 24 px. The score pill is absent from that list. It gets only the R5-D4-02 rule at 3080-3083 (padding: 5px 0; margin: -5px 0), which adds exactly 10 px and clears the 24 px fine floor at 25 px but knows nothing about the 44 px coarse floor.

evidence.unit: cells with at least one control under the card's own pointer-dependent floor, out of 528
evidence.machine: 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB RAM, darwin arm64
evidence.contention_note: Box shared with the other round-6 seats (load1 4.71 at the final run). Every number is a count, a pixel or a ratio from real layout, never a timing, so contention cannot move it.

findings.instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:_render (its emitted [data-stat="score"] element and the R5-D4-02 rule at 3080-3083) together with _coarsePointer() at 1310 and the htmlTargetFloor selector list it picks the pixel value for at 2969-2989

perturbation.change: Add the declarations the floor template applies to every other control to the card's own shadow root after render: node tools/audit/round6/D4/card_qa.mjs --only score_open --perturb '.hl-stat.hl-score{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;box-sizing:border-box}'
perturbation.observed_value: 12 -> 0 under_floor_cells over 24 cells (score_open only); overflow, overlap, contrast, hscroll and error cells all stay 0

findings.metric_definition: min(getBoundingClientRect().width, .height) in CSS px per control, against the card's own pointer floor (24 px fine, 44 px coarse); cells with >=1 control under the floor.

null_control.command: NODE_PATH=<tmp>/node_modules PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=~/.cache/pw-browsers HPO_PLANDATA=<plan>.json node tools/audit/round6/D4/card_qa.mjs --json /tmp/d4r6/final.json   (read the pointer=fine cells)
null_control.note: Fine-pointer cells are under_floor_cells=0. The effect is coarse-pointer-only and vanishes where the floor is 24 px, which is what the mechanism predicts.

reproduction_steps: Repeat with --perturb '.hl-stat.hl-score{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;box-sizing:border-box}' and watch under_floor_cells go 12 -> 0.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: One line: add .hl-stat.hl-score to the htmlTargetFloor selector list in heatpump-optimizer-card.js (2969-2989), with a comment in the group-comment style that block already uses. No new rule, no new token.

non_findings.claim: The counter harness is not a dead probe
Flow: 23 options pages (8 top menu, 15 advanced) and 197 registry rows, every row landing on a leaf page
Flow: every labelled field on every options page has help text in both strings.json and translations/sv.json
Flow: that help-coverage number moves when a data key loses its data_description, so the 0 above is a fact and not a dead probe
Flow: 10 of 23 pages group their fields with section(); the widest page is building at 23 fields; 5 pages exceed 12 fields
Flow: a first-time user reaches a first plan through the quick path in 3 screens, or the full questionnaire in 10

Flow: 4 groups are split in the registry table, so the rendered section order on those pages is not the table order (observation, not filed; the page/field/help coverage it rests on is already gated by tests/entities.py and tests/config_flow_steps.py)

Two observations recorded but not filed: (a) .chip has .chip:focus-visible and cursor:pointer but no .chip:hover rule, so a legend chip gives no hover feedback and no pixels of layout move; (b) the D4-01 score pill paints as plain headline text with no visual affordance, so it is invisible to a user that it is a control
non_findings.value: per-selector maxshift=0px for .chartwrap/.chip/.expand/.vc-out/.setup-hit; .chip viewctl_landed=0/12 (no .chip:hover rule exists)
